full_text:
The Apple of Paris was an ancient artifact that inspired the Greek myth, the Judgement of Paris. At some point it was obtained by Jason and the Argonauts and resided on the Argo after it was sunk just off the shores of Sutos.

History

Whilst diving down to the Argo to recover Jason's Hoplite Amulets, Zhalia Moon encountered the Apple of Paris among other items including the Golden Fleece and Hercules' Arrow. Placing a coin on the pedestal of the Golden Fleece unlocked the vault, as it was that that Jason has been after on his quest, allowing her to recover the chest of Dragon's teeth and the Amulets of the Hoplite Titans. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

}}The '''Apple of Paris''' was an ancient artifact that inspired the Greek myth, the Judgement of Paris. At some point it was obtained by [[Jason]] and the Argonauts and resided on the [[Argo]] after it was sunk just off the shores of [[Sutos]].
== History ==
Whilst diving down to the [[Argo]] to recover Jason's [[Hoplite]] [[Amulets]], [[Zhalia Moon]] encountered the Apple of Paris among other items including the [[Golden Fleece]] and [[Hercules' Arrow]]. Placing a coin on the pedestal of the Golden Fleece unlocked the vault, as it was that that Jason has been after on his quest, allowing her to recover the chest of [[Dragon's teeth]] and the Amulets of the Hoplite Titans. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}
